cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: Which of the following describes a continuous graph?

options.A: A graph showing the number of test questions answered correctly vs score
options.B: A graph showing the number of chairs in a classroom vs students
options.C: A graph showing the distance traveled by a car over time at a constant speed
options.D: A graph showing the number of books sold per day

cards.why:
**Step 1: Understand the difference between discrete and continuous**
Continuous graphs represent variables that can take on any real value (like fractions of a second or decimal distances), while discrete graphs represent countable, distinct items.

**Step 2: Evaluate options**
Test questions, chairs, and books are counted in whole numbers (discrete). Distance and time can be measured at any fractional moment, forming a continuous line.

**Step 3: Final Result**
**A graph showing the distance traveled by a car over time at a constant speed** is continuous.

cards.title: Solving equations and inequalities — the rules
body: **Linear equation:** do the same operation to both sides until x is alone. Example: 5x − 7 = 2x + 8 → 3x = 15 → x = 5. Check: 5(5) − 7 = 18 = 2(5) + 8 ✔.
**Equations with fractions:** multiply every term by the LCD first. (x/3) + (x/4) = 7 → 4x + 3x = 84 → x = 12.
**Absolute value:** |x − 2| = 5 means x − 2 = 5 or x − 2 = −5, so x = 7 or x = −3. (|x| = −1 has no solution.)

**Linear inequality:** same steps as an equation, BUT when you multiply or divide by a negative number, reverse the sign. −3x < 12 → x > −4. Show the answer on a number line (open circle for < or >, filled circle for ≤ or ≥) or in interval notation, e.g. (−4, ∞).

cards.title: 2.3.2 Inverse Variation
body: **Inverse variation:** y varies inversely as x when **xy = k** (a constant), i.e. y = k/x with k ≠ 0. When x is doubled, y is halved; when x gets larger, y gets smaller.

Example: Nejat rides her bicycle 6 km from home to Semhar Secondary School in Massawa. Her travel time x (hours) and her speed y (km/h) satisfy x·y = 6. If she rides at 12 km/h she needs 6 ÷ 12 = 0.5 h; at 18 km/h she needs 6 ÷ 18 = 1/3 h (20 minutes). Faster speed → shorter time.
The graph of y = 6/x (for x > 0) is a curve that falls from left to right and gets closer and closer to both axes without touching them.
**Finding k:** if y = 4 when x = 3, then k = xy = 12 and y = 12/x; so when x = 6, y = 2.

cards.title: Practice
cards.q: y varies inversely as x, and y = 6 when x = 4. Find y when x = 8.
cards.why: Inverse variation: xy = k. k = 4 × 6 = 24. When x = 8: y = 24 ÷ 8 = 3. Doubling x halves y. (12 would be direct variation.)

cards.title: Direct vs inverse: "divide or multiply"
body: **Direct:** y ÷ x stays the same (y = kx) — both go up together.
**Inverse:** y × x stays the same (y = k/x) — one up, the other down.

cards.q: Suppose $$y$$ varies directly with $$x$$. If the constant of proportionality $$k = 3.5$$, which equation represents this relationship?
cards.why:
**Step 1: Recall the direct variation equation**
Direct variation is written as $$y = kx$$.

**Step 2: Substitute $$k = 3.5$$**
$$y = 3.5x$$

**Step 3: Final Result**
The correct equation is **$$y = 3.5x$$**.
